investigation.title: Arena Agent Mode Complete Capability Inventory
investigation.scope: One real Agent Mode session: visible tool schemas, safe runtime probes, and first-party Arena documentation fetched during this session.
investigation.registry_completeness: The visible function definitions are the complete registry available to this investigator; hidden backend tools, feature flags, and all Arena account capabilities cannot be inspected.
investigation.validation_status: Validated by the final post-log T-015 check on 2026-09-26 UTC; no edits were made afterward.

evidence_classifications.OFFICIAL_DOCUMENTATION: First-party documentation was retrieved; this proves the source says it, not independent product behavior.
evidence_classifications.EXPOSED_TOOL: Tool/function schema was visible to this session; not execution evidence.
evidence_classifications.EXECUTION_VERIFIED: Operation ran and returned a recorded result; cite at least one test_id.
evidence_classifications.PARTIALLY_VERIFIED: Only a bounded portion was tested or the observation has a stated gap.
evidence_classifications.INFERRED: Practical conclusion, not a direct product promise.
evidence_classifications.NOT_TESTED: No independent test was run; dependency-blocked tests remain NOT_TESTED.
evidence_classifications.UNAVAILABLE: Not exposed in this session or absent from checked runtime locations; not a global Arena claim.

tools.output: Search result IDs, titles, URLs, descriptions/snippets, sometimes pageAge.
restrictions: Search snippets are not full-page evidence.
Result IDs are local to a result list.

tools.purpose: Retrieve a webpage as chunked Markdown-like text; tool description supports PDF parsing up to 30 pages.
tools.output: Title, URL, content, chunkIndex, hasMore, totalChunks.
restrictions: Long pages require more chunk requests.
PDF evidence only verified on a one-page public fixture.

tools.purpose: Run shell commands and child processes in the sandbox.
tools.input: command, optional cwd, timeout (default 30 seconds, maximum 1800 seconds)
tools.output: stdout, stderr, exit status/code, duration, truncation flags.

tools.purpose: Read workspace text; display images visibly; return metadata for other binary files.
tools.input: path, optional line offset and line limit
tools.output: Text, image rendering, or binary metadata.
restrictions: Binary decoding is not promised except visible image handling.

tools.purpose: Create or overwrite a workspace file from full text content.
restrictions: Writing does not validate file format.

tools.purpose: Replace first fuzzy-matched text occurrence in an existing file.
restrictions: First match only; not a semantic merge.

tools.purpose: Open one workspace file in the user's file viewer.
restrictions: A viewer open is not proof of file download.

tools.purpose: Start a long-running process with an optional live preview port.
tools.output: Process ID, logs, listening ports, warnings.
restrictions: Preview servers should bind to 0.0.0.0 and accept the proxied host.

tools.purpose: Read process logs/liveness and optionally wait for port/log/exit.
tools.input: process_id, tail_lines, wait_for condition, wait pattern, wait_timeout (maximum 180 seconds)
tools.output: Log tail, status, ports, wait result.

tools.purpose: Stop a process group started by start_process.
tools.output: Stopped status and final log tail.
restrictions: Tool description says SIGTERM followed by SIGKILL if needed.

tools.purpose: Generate a standalone image or edit supplied images.
tools.input: file_path, prompt, optional existing image paths, offer_options
restrictions: Options mode can pause for user choice.

tools.purpose: Search for images and save 1-5 results to workspace paths.
Audition two voice candidates and register a voice selected by the user.
tools.input: plain text audition script, BCP-47 language, voice identity options
restrictions: Pauses for user choice; a new pair uses an incremented index.

tools.purpose: Synthesize spoken-word audio to a supported audio file type.
tools.input: file_path, text up to 1500 characters, previously selected voice_id

tools.purpose: Ask clarification questions in a user-facing UI.
tools.input: Up to 6 questions, each with 2-4 choices and optional custom response.

tools.purpose: Invoke independent exposed developer tools together.
tools.input: List of tool names and parameter objects.
restrictions: Wrapper was used; exact concurrency/speedup was not benchmarked.
